description: This file handles Slack message processing, including context resolution, authorization, command parsing, mention detection, reaction handling, session recording, and message preparation for inbound Slack messages within a larger Slack integration system.

classes.name: SlackConversationContext
classes.description: Holds information about the Slack channel context, including channel details, type, permissions, and configuration.

classes.name: SlackAuthorizationContext
classes.description: Contains authorization details for a Slack message, including sender ID and permission levels.

classes.name: SlackRoutingContext
classes.description: Defines routing information for a Slack message, including route, chat type, reply mode, thread context, and session keys.

methods.name: resolveCachedMentionRegexes
methods.description: Builds or retrieves cached mention regexes for a given Slack context and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveSlackConversationContext
methods.description: Determines the context of a Slack conversation, including channel info, type, and configuration.

methods.name: authorizeSlackInboundMessage
methods.description: Performs authorization checks for incoming Slack messages, including bot, channel, and direct message permissions.

methods.name: resolveSlackRoutingContext
methods.description: Calculates routing details for a Slack message, including session and thread management.

methods.name: prepareSlackMessage
methods.description: Main function to process an incoming Slack message, perform authorization, context resolution, command parsing, reaction handling, session recording, and prepare the message for further processing.
